summary: Iteration 7 — Verified the 4 surgical backend logic fixes flagged in iteration_6. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase_c_fixes.py (13 focused tests) and re-ran the full Phase C regression (/app/backend/tests/test_phase_c_employment.py, 18 tests). ALL 31 tests PASS. (1) Decline-offer: applicant declining an 'offered' app sets status='declined', triggers a new 'Offer declined' notification on the owner (verified by title match + applicant name in body), and writes an event_log entry 'You declined the offer from Dovan's Street Kiosk' for the applicant; declining a still-'pending' application sets status='withdrawn' and produces NO 'Offer declined' notification for the owner (delta-counted before vs after to avoid false positives from prior runs). (2) Fire: after owner POST /businesses/{biz}/player-employees/{emp}/fire, the fired employee's GET /game/events contains 'You were let go from <biz>' (the existing 'You were let go' notification was already there in iter_6; this run confirms the new event_log entry is now also written). (3) Re-offer: first POST /offer on a 'pending' app triggers an applicant notification with title 'Job offer!' (job_offer counter incremented by 1, offer_updated counter unchanged); a SECOND POST /offer on the now-'offered' app with a different wage (60 -> 85) updates wage_offer in business_applications AND increments only the 'Offer updated' counter — no duplicate 'Job offer!' notification is sent. (4) Shift hours validation: POST /jobs/employment/{emp}/work with hours in {1,3,5,7,9} returns HTTP 400 with detail containing 'Shift length must be 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours.' and does NOT create a player_shift activity (verified via mongo); hours in {2,4,6,8} return 200 and start the activity. time_scale verified == 1.0.
critical_code_review_comments: decline_business_offer (server.py ~L1483): correct separation of 'declined' vs 'withdrawn' status based on prior state; only emits owner notif on the offer-decline path. Clean implementation, matches contract.

offer_player (server.py ~L1541): the was_offered branch correctly fires 'Offer updated' instead of duplicate 'Job offer!'. Consider including the previous wage in the notification body for context (e.g. 'updated to $85/shift (was $60)'), but not blocking.
fire_player (server.py ~L1578): both notification and add_event are now present — symmetrical with quit_player_job. Good.

work_player_shift (server.py ~L1497): explicit 400 with helpful detail. Pydantic-level Literal[2,4,6,8] in WorkBody would push validation even earlier, but the current implementation is correct and returns the more helpful 400 detail string.

Larger structural note (carried forward from iter_6): server.py is now ~1945 lines — employment endpoints (NPC apply, market, hiring, employment, shift work) would map cleanly to /app/backend/routers/employment.py and save ~250 lines. Not urgent for these fixes but worth tackling before Phase D.

applicant_snapshot top_skills refactor (employment.py ~L127): not exercised directly in this run, but the iter_6 regression (TestOwnerHiring.test_owner_sees_applications_with_snapshot — asserts a.get('stats') is truthy and recommended_wage > 0) still passes, confirming the refactor returns the expected list-of-{skill,level} shape.
